summary: Kenvue filed an 8-K reporting an October 9, 2026 third supplemental indenture eliminating substantially all restrictive covenants, most events of default, the SEC reporting covenant, and merger/asset-transfer limits on its Existing Kenvue Notes. Kimberly-Clark solicited consents on Kenvue's behalf alongside exchange offers of any and all Existing Kenvue Notes for up to $7.0 billion of new Kimberly-Clark notes plus cash. The amendments strip bondholder protections, easing the change-of-control path. Watch exchange participation, remaining Note overhang, and Kimberly-Clark financing conditions ahead of closing.
